name: sim_ac5_mock_merch_order_lookup_and_damaged_item
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. I am here to help you with race schedules, team gear, and everything Silver Arrows.
User: Can you check the status of my merch order #1001, and what should I do if the cap arrived damaged?
Agent Action: Call Tool lookup_mock_merch_order with args {'order_id': '1001'}
Agent: In our simulated mock demo system, order 1001 for your Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team Gear is marked as delivered by DHL Express with tracking number DHL MB 984210. Since your cap arrived damaged, you are eligible for a free replacement or return within 30 days at the official store, shop.mercedesamgf1.com.
User: Thank you for that information. I will follow the steps on the website to request my replacement.
Agent: You are very welcome, and I am glad I could help you with that. I hope your new cap arrives in perfect condition so you can keep supporting the Silver Arrows in style. Please let me know if there is anything else you need, whether it is about your gear or the upcoming races.
User: Actually, I have one more question: is there a way to track the return shipping once I send the damaged item back?
Agent Action: Call Tool get_official_links with args {'category': 'merch'}
Agent: Once you start your return at the official store, shop.mercedesamgf1.com, you will receive a return label and a new tracking number to follow your package. The store portal will keep you updated on the status of your replacement as soon as they process the damaged item.
User:

step_details.goal: Check the status of Mercedes merch order #1001 and ask what to do if the cap arrived damaged
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up order #1001 using the lookup tool, reports the Delivered status, explains the return/exchange/damaged-item options, and clearly discloses that the merch support flow is mocked/simulated. Receiving the mocked order status and damaged-item guidance counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The goal was successfully completed, but the user continued the conversation.

expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called the tool with the correct order ID and correctly reported that the status was 'Delivered' with tracking number 'DHL MB 984210'.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent explained return, exchange, or damaged-item options
expectation_details.justification: The agent explicitly stated that the user is eligible for a free replacement or return within 30 days at the official shop website.
